main._resource_name: chart-score, chart-trend, chart-owner, chart-prov, chart-ses, chart-sector, chart-city, chart-cityheat, chart-age, kpi:measures — indicator identity (one resource per indicator); known names map to a definition
main.measurement_year: chart-trend, chart-score, kpi:years, insight:trend — also picks each indicator's reference year
main.month: chart-trend, chart-score — detects partial years (fewer than 12 months); rates show no seasonality (72-73% every month)
main.provider: chart-prov, chart-owner, kpi:providers, insight:owner — operating body (MoH / HMO / municipality) derived from the provider name
main.Socio Economic Group: chart-ses, insight:ses — cluster 1-10; unknown excluded and disclosed
main.sector: chart-sector, insight:sector — unknown excluded and disclosed
main.age_range: chart-age, insight:age — mother's age bands for maternal measures; 0-120 means no split
main.target: chart-score, kpi:met, insight:target — 0 means no target that year
main.number_of_cases: chart-score, chart-trend, chart-owner, chart-prov, chart-ses, chart-sector, chart-city, chart-cityheat, chart-age, kpi:cases — denominator
main.number_of_cases_approved: chart-score, chart-trend, chart-owner, chart-prov, chart-ses, chart-sector, chart-city, chart-cityheat, chart-age, insight:range — numerator; empty means zero
main.subject_desc: skip: not fetched (columns lever, 5M rows); domain per indicator, constant within each resource
main.measure_code: skip: not fetched; one resource per indicator, so the resource name is the key
main.measure_description: skip: not fetched; duplicates the resource name (truncated to 25 chars)
main.measure_long_description: skip: not fetched (186MB per 2M rows); definitions of known indicators are kept in compute.DEFINITIONS
main.measurement_start_year: skip: not fetched; constant per indicator
main.provider_ownership: skip: not fetched; identical to the operating body derived from provider
main.station: skip: not fetched (1,000+ stations); station lookup is the shell's explorer
main.gender: skip: not fetched; no gap (rates within 1.5 points by child gender in every indicator)
main.day_range: skip: not fetched; no gap (within 0.5 points between day ranges)
main.week_pregnancy_group_range: skip: not fetched; filled for one indicator only
